sentences.text: Shri Ankit Saxena - Advocate for the appellant.

Shri Arvind Singh - Government Advocate for the respond
Heard on I.A. No.14318/2025, an application under Section 389(1) of Cr.P.C. for suspension of
sentence and grant of bail to appellant - Akash Malviya.

The appellant is aggrieved of the judgment dated 14.05.2025 passed by the learned Special Judge,
(SC/ST Atrocity Act), Bhopal in SC ATR No.110/2020, whereby the appellant Akash Malviya stands convicted and sentenced as under :-
 Conviction Sent  
 Section Act Imprisonment Fine  
 376-D IPC R.I. for 20 years Rs.1,000/-
 342 I.P.C. R.I. for 6 years Rs.500/- 
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that there are general and omnibus allegations against appellant Akash Malviya.
In paragraph-11 of her cross-examination, she had admitted that Akash was not known to her and Akash had also arrived in police station where police had informed that that person was Akash.
Main allegation is against the Dev Singh qua whose DNA report is positive.
There are good chances of success in the appeal.
Hence, prayer is made to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the appellant Akash and to release him on bail.
2 CRA-5711-2025 Shri Arvind Singh, learned Public Prosecutor for the State, in his turn, opposes the prayer for suspension of sentence and grant of bail.

sentences.text: After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the record so also the fact that the appeal is going to take time for its disposal, without commenting on the merits of the case, we are of the considered opinion that this is a fit case to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the appellant Akash and to release him on bail.

It is directed that on depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing a personal bond to the tune of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with two solvent sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the trial court on 26.03.2026 and such other dates as may be fixed by the trial court, the execution of remaining part of the jail sentence imposed upon appellant shall remain suspended and he shall be released on bail till final disposal of this appeal.
I.A.No.14318/2025 is allowed & disposed of.
List the case for final hearing in Part-B of the cause list as per its turn and seniority.
